provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Pins the instant just after an action ends: the event is over and the moment is now (今ちょうど着いたところです). Its class siblings are 〜ていたところ, the action still under way, and 〜たばかり, which presents an event as recent and tolerates real elapsed time (去年買ったばかり). 〜たところ resists past adverbs like 三日前に and does not modify a noun: 買ったばかりの服, not 買ったところの服.

examples.ruby: 今[いま]ちょうど駅[えき]に着[つ]いたところです。
examples.english: I've just this second arrived at the station.

examples.ruby: 手紙[てがみ]の返事[へんじ]を書[か]き終[お]えたところだ。
examples.english: I've just finished writing my reply.

examples.ruby: たった今[いま]、母[はは]から電話[でんわ]をもらったとこだよ。
examples.english: My mom called me literally a second ago.

patterns.usage_note: Freezes an action that was still in progress, typically at the point something interrupts it (シャワーを浴びていたところに宅配便が来た), and with 〜ようと思っていたところ announces you were on the verge of doing the very thing being asked about. Its class siblings are 〜たところ, the moment just after the action finished, and 〜たばかり, which reports an event as recent.

examples.ruby: ちょうど君[きみ]に連絡[れんらく]しようと思[おも]っていたところだ。
examples.english: I was just about to get in touch with you, actually.

examples.ruby: さっきまで庭[にわ]で草[くさ]を抜[ぬ]いてたとこなんだ。
examples.english: Up until a moment ago I was out in the yard pulling weeds.

examples.ruby: シャワーを浴[あ]びていたところに宅配便[たくはいびん]が来[き]た。
examples.english: I was in the shower when the delivery guy showed up.

patterns.usage_note: Presents an action as recent in the speaker's judgment rather than by the clock, so it accepts a real stretch of elapsed time (三年前に建ったばかりのビル) where its sibling 〜たところ, the instant just after the action, does not. It also modifies a noun directly (買ったばかりの車), which 〜たところ cannot. After a noun ばかり carries the unrelated limiting sense "nothing but"; this lane is "only just".

examples.ruby: この町[まち]には先月[せんげつ]引[ひ]っ越[こ]してきたばかりです。
examples.english: I only moved to this town last month.

examples.ruby: 起[お]きたばっかりで頭[あたま]が回[まわ]らない。
examples.english: I just woke up, so my brain isn't working yet.

examples.ruby: その車[くるま]、去年[きょねん]買[か]ったばかりなのに壊[こわ]れた。
examples.english: That car broke down even though I only bought it last year.
